Name: Sonoma County Reentry Services (Probation Department)
Description: Coordinates case management, transitional housing referrals, job support, mental health services for adults exiting jail or on probation.
Tags: case management; housing; employment; mental health; probation
Eligibility Requirements: Adults on probation or recently released from jail in Sonoma County

Name: Reach for Home
Description: Provides transitional and permanent supportive housing, employment support and life coaching for reentry clients in Healdsburg and northern Sonoma.

Name: North Bay Legal Aid – Sonoma Office
Description: Free expungement and housing legal services for low-income and justice-involved individuals in Sonoma County.

Name: Napa County Reentry Services (Health & Human Services)
Description: Housing assistance, behavioral health, case management and employment navigation for formerly incarcerated adults in Napa County.
Tags: housing; employment; case management; behavioral health

Name: On The Move – VOICES Napa
Description: Supports formerly incarcerated youth and young adults with education reentry, housing navigation and trauma-informed case support.
Eligibility Requirements: Young adults ages 15–24 with justice system history

Name: Mentis Mental Health Napa
Description: Therapy, anger management, trauma recovery, and addiction recovery services tailored to reentry clients, including dual diagnosis.
Eligibility Requirements: Napa County residents with reentry needs
